items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Well the better track record started when I went with Blanche Calloway.

ctx.x: Well let's see, you just told about how you struck out on the three different gigs, and when did you start to have a better track record?

Well the better track record started when I went with Blanche Calloway. Then's when I started to realize what it was all about. Ben Webster was in the band, Edgar Battle, Clyde Hart, and we'd start playing shows. Blanche Calloway.
